limits: This scores exact evidence/claim identities for fixed metric tasks, not open-ended answers or arbitrary Chinese/English questions.
Gold packets were developer selected and labelled by the same AI model used for reranking; independent expert validation remains absent.
Unlabelled returned passages are not known irrelevant; Precision may undercount semantically valid evidence.
The frozen scorer divides precision by actual returned count up to K; empty output with empty Gold is scored 1. Ranking-blind and policy-probe results must remain separate.
Domain routing is checked against configured fixed metric dependencies, not independent natural-language intent recognition.
Invalid-evidence/applicability rates cover annotated invalid span IDs only; zero does not prove every other passage suitable.
Latency observations use concurrency and warmed queries and cannot support a latency improvement, P95 or significance claim.
Explicit conflict detection has one case; arbitrary contradictions in prose are not automatically detected.
Observed metric differences do not grant personal explanation, numerical candidate or scientific validation authority.
